newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moody's confirms Eridania debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Eridania debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it confirmed the A3 senior debt ratings of Eridania Beghin-Say and of its guaranteed subsidiary American Maize Products company, now renamed Cerestar SA.
Moody's had placed the debt ratings under review for possible downgrade on June 5. The confirmation affects approximately $540 million of debt.

"The confirmation reflects the strategic value of EBS's acquisition of certain assets of Compagnie Francaise de Sucrerie, and Moody's expectation that EBS will be able to restore its financial measurements, which the acquisition will cause to deteriorate," the statement said.
